Menacing.Name: Menacing
Menacing.SelectToken: Select a token you own to toggle Menacing.
Menacing.ToggleError: Could not toggle Menacing. See the console for details.

YourTurn.EnabledHint: GM-controlled world setting. Play turn cut-ins for everyone; players cannot override this setting.
YourTurn.ScaleHint: GM-controlled size for everyone's cut-ins, from half size to one and a half. 1 is the default.
YourTurn.PortraitWidthHint: World-wide exact display width for every turn portrait at Your Turn Scale 1 (100–1000 px; default 400). Small images enlarge and large images shrink without stretching. Height follows the image's proportions; tall art or large values can extend beyond the backdrop. No hidden fit-down cap. Applies to the next turn or preview; the GM's overall scale also applies.
YourTurn.HoldHint: GM-controlled hold duration for everyone's cut-ins, in seconds.
YourTurn.SoundHint: Sound plays once and can finish after the card disappears. Uses your Interface volume. Stop preview stops the sound too.
YourTurn.PlacementHint: Arrows move 10 px; hold Shift for 1 px. Scale is relative to the GM's portrait width. Changes update your open preview; Save applies them to this actor.
YourTurn.PreviewHint: Preview stays visible until stopped, closed, or replaced. Placement changes do not replay its sound.
